nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

**What it does:** your video + one picture of a character -> the same clip with that person swapped (the Higgsfield Genjutsu idea, run on your own PC: nothing is uploaded and nothing blocks the clip).

1. Load **your video** and a **character picture** (best: a sheet with a front view, a back view and the face).
2. **Who to replace**: one sentence, e.g. `big man in the black and gold patterned outfit`. It goes into the Character Swap LoRA card's prompt.
3. **Seconds** = 0 does the whole clip: it runs in 5.2 s passes, and every pass continues from the last 22 frames of the one before (core Start Loop / End Loop nodes). Or set a number to do only the start.
4. **Turbo** on = 4 steps (the Ref2V turbo LoRA). Off = 20 steps, much slower.
5. **Keep the original sound** puts your clip's own audio back on.
6. **Model files**: all six loaders are on the main node. If your files sit in a subfolder (e.g. `MiniMax-H3/`), pick them there once.

| Clip (0.4 MP, Turbo) | Length | Passes | RTX 3060 |
|---|---|---|---|
| wheelbarrow -> penguin | 6.7 s | 2 | 11:56 |
| van -> raccoon | 7.0 s | 2 | 10:53 |
| wrestler -> penguin | 8.3 s | 2 | 11:25 |
| gym guy -> dog | 8.1 s | 2 | 11:17 |
| dance -> dog | 9.8 s | 3 | 17:27 |

From the LoRA card: shots of 4-5 s work best, one person at a time, hard cuts in the clip confuse it. Megapixels is the time knob (0.4 MP fits 12 GB; more spills into RAM).

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)

nodes.title: Downloads
widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

**[Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| all | `diffusion_models/` | [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 21.0 GB |
| Turbo (4 steps) | `loras/` | [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) | 2.0 GB |
| all | `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) | 15.7 GB |
| all | `vae/` | [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 2.8 GB |
| all | `vae/` | [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | 0.6 GB |

**[akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA](https://huggingface.co/akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| the swap | `loras/` | [h3_character_swap_pro4500_1000.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA/resolve/main/h3_character_swap_pro4500_1000.safetensors) | 0.2 GB |

_Tested on: RTX 3060 12 GB · 32 GB RAM · ComfyUI 0.39.2._

No custom nodes: core ComfyUI **0.39 or newer** (loop nodes + MiniMax H3). License: MiniMax H3 Community License (the model and the LoRA) - read it before commercial use. Swap in characters, not real people's faces.
